The function was tested against **36 test cases** covering:

| Category | Examples | Result |
|---|---|---|
| Classic LeetCode | `"A man, a plan, a canal: Panama"` → `true`, `"race a car"` → `false` | ✅ |
| Empty / whitespace-only | `""`, `" "` → `true` | ✅ |
| Pure alphanumeric | `"racecar"`, `"RaceCar"`, `"RACECAR"` → `true` | ✅ |
| Numeric palindromes | `"12321"`, `"123321"` → `true`, `"12345"` → `false` | ✅ |
| Mixed alpha-numeric | `"a1b2b1a"`, `"A1b2B1a"` → `true` | ✅ |
| Common phrase palindromes | `"No 'x' in Nixon"`, `"Was it a car or a cat I saw?"`, `"Madam, I'm Adam"` → `true` | ✅ |
| Single character | `"a"`, `"Z"`, `"1"` → `true` | ✅ |
| Two characters | `"aa"`, `"Aa"` → `true`; `"ab"` → `false` | ✅ |
| Non-alphanumeric only | `"!@#$%"`, `"..."` → `true` | ✅ |
| Leading/trailing junk | `",racecar,"` → `true`; `"!!hello!!"` → `false` | ✅ |
| Unicode letters | `"Á"`, `"ÁÁ"` → `true`; `"Áa"` → `false` | ✅ |
| Punctuation boundaries | `"a!!!a"` → `true`; `"a!!!b"` → `false` | ✅ |
